translation: Then, for the chills and fever that are in the exterior and also have the Taiyang signs, if there is sweating one should use Guizhi, and if there is no sweating one should use Mahuang (Ephedra); for the chills and fever that are half-interior half-exterior and also have the Shaoyang signs, one should treat it with Xiaochaihu Tang (Minor Bupleurum Decoction) with additions and subtractions. As for that wherein ying and wei are debilitated and [the person] has chills and fever, Huangqi Jianzhong (Tang) (Astragalus Center-Fortifying Decoction) and Babu Tang (Eight-Ingredient Decoction) and the like govern it. That Jiegu alone ascribes the single Guizhi pattern to the Yang Wei seems not yet fully extended/developed.
